notes: Dev-split ABox contraction paired with physics-replace-d001: removes "The muon is a lepton." (in_particle_family, functional). The direct, paraphrase and cross-lingual questions ask the original fact with "does not know" as the target. The one related question asks whether the muon is an elementary particle (yes before). The derived questions are the cardinality question (is the muon a quark: no before) and two 2-hop compositions through the removed fact: the meaning of the Greek root of the family name, and the size of the muon's family. KNOWN LEAKS, since the schema has no per-query flag: the cardinality question is overdetermined (the six quark flavours are a stored closed list that excludes the muon, and the muon has no quark structure), and "the muon is an elementary particle" is stored on its own and survives the removal, so a model that keeps it still answers yes on the related question. Report derived[0] and related[0] apart from the 2-hop questions. The prompts say "particle class" where needed, because "family" can also mean generation. The near unrelated question keeps the subject (the muon's charge); contraction is exempt from Rule 7. Evidence for the leak: Dolma counts of 0 for "muon is not a quark", "muons are not quarks" and "muon is a quark" (re-run 2026-11-12), and Wikipedia's Muon article ("with no quark structure").
